hotels.description: Set across 65 acres of native bushland and gardens in Cowes, Ramada Resort by Wyndham Phillip Island is a family-friendly retreat perfectly placed for exploring Phillip Island. Every member of the family can find days of excitement just nearby at attractions such as The Koala Conservation Centre, the famous Penguin Parade and the Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit. Back at the resort, comprehensive facilities keep the whole family occupied. Three swimming pools, two tennis courts, a kids' club and an arcade cater to younger guests, while two health centres with a fitness centre and spa pool give adults plenty of reason to slow down. Flametrees Restaurant and Bar serves woodfired pizzas, and self-contained villas make it easy to cook in if you prefer.
